purpose: Alternate artwork keyframes for exported animated loops; original scenes remain immutable.

keyframes.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: alternate animation keyframe for an existing paired day/night pixel-art wallpaper. Edit target is the supplied image. KEEP exact 1536x1024 dimensions, left day / right night halves, camera, perspective, architecture and all object positions. Preserve the original pixel-art style. ONLY change the moving or luminous elements described below; every static surface must remain as close to pixel-identical as possible. This is deliberately a clearly different animation phase, not a new scene. No text additions, UI, borders, labels or watermark. Animate a later moment: redraw the small flowing stream at the lower RIGHT with distinctly shifted white ripples and flowing highlights, preserving its banks and stepping stones; water flows downhill toward the viewer. In both panels make the vending-machine display illumination noticeably dimmer while keeping the red cabinet exactly unchanged. At night dim some existing house-window lights and lanterns, leaving others lit, and change brightness of the existing tiny stars without moving them or changing the moon. Keep foliage, sky, clouds, poles, street and railway fixed. Don't add a train.
